source_title: How Ios In App Payment Works For One Time Purchases
source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; page undated in search index

snippets.snippet_text: "As with all one-time purchases, successfully processed sales on iOS in-app purchases are also subject to Patreon's 10% standard platform fee and currency conversion fees (if applicable), applied to the sale amount before sales tax. Patreon does not charge a payment processing fee on iOS in-app purchase transactions."
